restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรม สไมล์โซไซตี้ (Smile Society)
text:
Great local clinic right next to Ari BTS station.
Friendly staff and the dentists speak English. I was treated by Dr. Tip who spoke to me in perfect English and was very helpful and thorough.
Very reasonable prices - I was quoted ridiculous prices by international BK clinics for simple extractions and fillings, so went here for a second opinion and had the treatment done for less than half the price - fillings 700/each, extractions 1000/each.
A good and cheap dental clinic!

text: I went for root canal treatment in preparation for future orthodontic treatment. They only told me it was treatable, so I had it done here for over 4000 baht. However, I later discovered at another clinic that this clinic didn't address the root canal problem at all and I have to start the process all over again. When I requested the treatment documentation from this clinic so I could use it for treatment elsewhere, they refused to provide it, especially the staff at the counter. They were completely unhelpful and uninterested, even though I paid for the treatment. It's as if they didn't want me to know what treatments were done. I will definitely not be receiving treatment here again. It feels like I wasted money without any solution, having to start the root canal treatment all over again. If they weren't capable of treating it properly from the start, they should have just said so.
